description: Expander adding eight more snapshot slots to 8FACE mk2, placed immediately to the right of it or of another +8.

params.text: Short-press applies this snapshot to the modules bound by 8FACE mk2, or in write mode stores their current presets into it; long-press clears it.

notes: the expander carries no settings of its own; the modules bound, the sequencing and the write mode are all set on the 8FACE mk2.
menu: Save, Load, Clear, Copy, Paste, Randomize and save, Shift front, Shift back and Custom label — on a snapshot button's own right-click menu.
